en: Oh, it looks like something's shining...
That's a rather beautiful glimmer...{SAUT}I wish to observe it closer.
Wait, is it safe? It could be a trap!
Hmm, the more I look at it, the more{SAUT}mysterious its shine becomes. Could{SAUT}such an aura... be replicated with paint?
Fox is useless once he gets like{SAUT}this. Just ignore what he says.{PAGE}But―more importantly! It looks like{SAUT}there's something unusual there.{SAUT}Check it out, Joker!
*sigh* I should've brought my art{SAUT}supplies...{PAGE}Grr... How careless could I be!?
